messages:
maya: Heads-up — our RevOps dashboard shows ~0.9% of inbound leads are unowned >15m during enrichment spikes this week. Thinking a short 'warm window' fallback to an overflow rotation could stop cold leads from going dark. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

dan: Do we have slices by region/time? canary first?

liam: Quick snapshot: spikes align with enrichment queue backlog around the 60s TTL mark. We can probably avoid permanent dead-assigns by letting a partial payload route after a short grace.

sasha: Sales concern: we don't want claim churn. If fallback is too aggressive we'll bounce owners and kill conversion. Need score gating.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: 5m owner hold window, then open a 10m "warm window" where leads can be claimed by overflow rotation. Only fallback if enrichment_status in ["pending","retry"] AND lead_score >= 0.30. If score < 0.30 send to nurture queue. Canary in EMEA.

dan: Can you share the HubSpot workflow pseudo? also who owns the canary rollout?

maya: Here's a simple rule sketch:
```
Trigger: new lead created
Conditions: enrichment_status IN (pending, retry)
  AND time_since_created > 5m
  AND lead_score >= 0.30
Action: set property `fallback_candidate` = true; route to `overflow_rotation` list
```

liam: Add SFDC guard: if sfdc.lead.assigned_recently == true then skip fallback. Also TTL on cached enrichment payloads should be 10m so we don't claim on stale data.

sasha: Also suggest rotation skip for reps with last_claim_at < 2h to avoid hot-swap churn. And metric to monitor: `claims_via_warm_window` + churn rate. If churn > 2% we rollback.

maya: Action owners: @dan implement HubSpot workflow + canary, @liam add SFDC dedupe guard and adjust cache TTL, @sasha define final score threshold and churn guard, @maya will add observability (alerts + dashboard). Canary target: Wed 10:00 PT. Rollback plan: revert workflow and immediately notify #marketing + #sales-oncall.

hubspot-bot: Workflow created: warm-window-fallback-canary (id:98765) by dan

dan: I'll tag the canary workspace and schedule the 10am test. Will add a dry-run toggle to only mark `fallback_candidate` without reassigning for the first hour.

sasha: LGTM. If we see claim churn >2% or conversion drop >1ppt during canary we abort.

maya: I'll add smoke alert in Console: metric `leads_claimed_via_warm_window` + heartbeat to Slack channel #marketing. Also will set an eval to track MQL->SQL conversion delta for canary cohort.

dan: One last Q — round-robin behavior: keep the rotation but prefer reps with timezone overlap and skip reps who are at capacity. Implementation note: `rotation.skip_if_busy = true` and `rotation.max_claims_per_hour = 3`.

liam: Noted. I'll update the rotation service flags.

maya: Summary of next steps:
- dan: implement workflow (dry-run flag) and kick off canary Wed 10am PT
- liam: SFDC dedupe guard + cache TTL to 10m + rotation skip config
- sasha: finalize score cutoff and churn thresholds
- maya: dashboards, alerts, eval set, notify sales

Please add any missing edges. :white_check_mark:

dan: Adding runbook snippet to the workflow ticket now.

sasha: :thumbsup:
